contract.entrypoint: stdio or streamable-http through the runtime broker
contract.auth: GitHub credentials are injected by the credential broker; agents never receive tokens.
contract.inputSchema: MCP tool schemas advertised by the pinned server at startup.
contract.outputSchema: MCP tool results plus RepoMesh audit envelope containing agent, project, repository, task and run ids.
contract.retryPolicy: Retry read-only calls up to 2 times with the same audit id; do not retry write calls unless the tool exposes an idempotency key.
contract.audit: Record server id, tool name, args hash, result status, latency and redacted error.
contract.degradedMode: Block SCM-dependent planning or delivery and report a governed blocker.

contract.entrypoint: stdio or streamable-http through the runtime broker
contract.auth: Public documentation access or brokered credentials when configured.
contract.inputSchema: MCP tool schemas advertised by the pinned server at startup.
contract.outputSchema: MCP tool results plus RepoMesh audit envelope containing agent, project, repository, task and run ids.
contract.retryPolicy: Retry read-only lookups up to 2 times with the same audit id.
contract.audit: Record server id, tool name, query hash, source refs, result status, latency and redacted error.
contract.degradedMode: Continue only when approved repository context is sufficient; otherwise report a blocker.

contract.entrypoint: stdio or streamable-http through the runtime broker
contract.auth: No direct secrets; browser sessions are isolated per task unless a brokered profile is explicitly approved.
contract.inputSchema: MCP tool schemas advertised by the pinned server at startup.
contract.outputSchema: MCP tool results plus RepoMesh audit envelope containing agent, project, repository, task and run ids.
contract.retryPolicy: Retry navigation and read-only inspection once; do not retry form submission or mutation without an idempotency key.
contract.audit: Record server id, tool name, URL origin, screenshot/artifact refs, result status, latency and redacted error.
contract.degradedMode: Mark web_e2e evidence missing and return the task for alternate validation.
